title: Amid Myanmar’s Civil War, the Rich Seek Parties and ‘Positive Vibes Only’
summary_full: The lifestyles of the wealthy in Myanmar — nightclubs, caviar and trips abroad — have been largely untouched by years of deadly conflict.
